scope: Adds durable, profile-scoped minimum saved-answer and question-match confidence settings. Defaults preserve the current 80% saved-answer and 75% question-match gates. The UI saves and reloads settings, filters suggestions, and disables export when selected saved answers fall below the active profile policy; the API rechecks policy at export. Existing verified and user-approved saved-answer requirements, per-job review, sensitive/legal exclusions, profile isolation, stale-version checks, immutable local export and external-submission-off behavior remain enforced.
